description: This file defines a Swift class NotifyOverlayController that manages a lightweight, borderless notification overlay window in a macOS app, providing in-app 'toast' notifications independent of the system Notification Center. It includes UI components built with SwiftUI, window management, and animation logic.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for displaying, updating, and dismissing a lightweight overlay notification panel in a macOS application.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays a notification overlay with a specified title and body, optionally auto-dismissing after a specified duration.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the currently visible notification overlay.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window if it isn't already created.

methods.name: presentWindow
methods.description: Prepares and displays the overlay window on screen.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target position and size of the overlay window based on screen dimensions.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the frame of the overlay window, with optional animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the overlay based on its content.
